product.name: Altinity.Cloud
product.description: A managed ClickHouse service offering 24/7 support, scalable deployment, and flexible cloud or on-premises operation without vendor lock-in.

product.name: Altinity Support for ClickHouse
product.description: Expert 24/7 support service for ClickHouse users, including troubleshooting, optimization, bug fixes, and security guidance.

product.name: Altinity Administrator Training for ClickHouse
product.description: In-depth live training program teaching ClickHouse administration, operation, troubleshooting, and optimization.

product.name: Altinity Kubernetes Operator for ClickHouse
product.description: An open-source Kubernetes operator that automates deployment, scaling, and management of ClickHouse clusters on Kubernetes.

product.name: Altinity Backup for ClickHouse
product.description: An open-source tool for efficient backup and restoration of ClickHouse databases supporting multiple storage backends and incremental backups.
